name: Quiplash
subtitle: Write the funniest answer. Win the head-to-head vote.
description: Everyone answers silly prompts on their phone. Each prompt goes to two players, and their answers face off on the TV while everyone else votes. Rounds 1 and 2 are head-to-head; in the final round everyone answers the same prompt.
